newsitem.title: POLAND: Business climate warms among Polish banks - survey.
newsitem.headline: Business climate warms among Polish banks - survey.

text.p: The business confidence index in the Polish banking sector rose by five points to 50.3 points in September -- the highest level so for this year, according to a poll by the Pentor institute released on Wednesday.

The monthly survey, commissioned by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP), also showed 50 percent of banks want further engagement of foreign capital, while 31 percent said foreign aquisitions should be curbed.
The survey, which polled 208 bank managers, showed the highest confidence among branch managers of the state savings bank PKO BP at 59.6 points. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
